ConnectionStrings._comment: LocalDB (current) - slower startup, auto-starts when needed. For faster performance, use full SQL Server: Server=localhost;Database=LogoDesignPortalDb;Trusted_Connection=true;TrustServerCertificate=true;

Email._comment: See EMAIL_SETUP_GUIDE.md for configuration instructions. For Gmail, use App Password (not regular password). Leave empty to show reset link on page instead of sending email.
